title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
lede: agent-desktop is a Vercel Labs CLI that lets AI agents operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading each app's accessibility tree, with no screenshots or pixel matching.

points: A snapshot returns the app's UI as JSON, with a ref for each element the agent can act on.
The agent clicks or types on a ref, then snapshots again to confirm the result; there is no model inside the tool.
Refs are tied to one snapshot, so a changed UI returns a stale-ref error instead of acting on the wrong element.
Actions run headless by default through the accessibility API, without moving the pointer or stealing focus.
It ships as a CLI, a C library and an MCP server exposing every command as a tool, under Apache 2.0.
